verses.sloka: विज्ञाय तु मनस्तस्य राघवस्य महात्मनः।सन्निवृत्याहवात्तस्मात् संविवेश पुरं ततः ।। ६.८१.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: vijñāya tu manastasya rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ।sannivṛtyāhavāttasmāt saṁviveśa puraṁ tataḥ ।। 6.81.1 ।।

translations.english: Knowing the highsouled Raghava's mind, Indrajith departed from there and entered the city.
translations.hindi: जब वह घोर ओर बीरों का नाश करने वाला युद्ध निरन्तर हो रहा था, तब लड़ने के लिए उत्सुक अङ्गद ने कम्पन का सामना किआ

verses.sloka: सो ऽनुस्मृत्य वधं तेषां राक्षसानां तरस्विनाम्।क्रोधताम्रेक्षणः शूरो निर्जगाम महाद्युतिः ।। ६.८१.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: so 'nusmṛtya vadhaṁ teṣāṁ rākṣasānāṁ tarasvinām।krodhatāmrekṣaṇaḥ śūro nirjagāma mahādyutiḥ ।। 6.81.2 ।।

translations.english: Recollecting those Rakshasas killed, the heroic, mighty and courageous Indrajith's eyes were red in anger.

verses.sloka: स पश्चिमेन द्वारेण निर्ययौ राक्षसैर्वृतः।इन्द्रजित्तु महावीर्यः पौलस्त्यो देवकण्टकः ।। ६.८१.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa paścimena dvāreṇa niryayau rākṣasairvṛtaḥ।indrajittu mahāvīryaḥ paulastyo devakaṇṭakaḥ ।। 6.81.3 ।।

translations.english: Paulastya (one of the nine mind born sons of Brahma, a scion of sage Paulastya), stupendous hero, a tormentor of Devatas, Indrajith, surrounded by Rakshasas came out through the western gate.

verses.sloka: इन्द्रजित्तु ततो दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।रणायाभ्युद्यतौ वीरौ मायां प्रादुष्करोत्तदा ।। ६.८१.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: indrajittu tato dṛṣṭvā bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau।raṇāyābhyudyatau vīrau māyāṁ prāduṣkarottadā ।। 6.81.4 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith, also witnessing the two brothers Rama and Lakshmana prepared for war, exhibited his trickery.
translations.hindi: उस कम्पन को युद्ध में मरा हुआ देख, शोणिताक्ष ने निर्भय हो अपना रथ बड़ी शीघ्रता से अंगद की ओर हँकवाया

verses.sloka: इन्द्रजित्तु रथे स्थाप्य सीतां मायामयीं ततः।बलेन महता ऽ ऽवृत्य तस्या वधमरोचयत् ।। ६.८१.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: indrajittu rathe sthāpya sītāṁ māyāmayīṁ tataḥ।balena mahatā ' 'vṛtya tasyā vadhamarocayat ।। 6.81.5 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith, also through a trick, wanted to make illusory Sita and place her in the chariot surrounded by Rakshasas and thought of killing her.

verses.sloka: मोहनार्थं तु सर्वेषां बुद्धिं कृत्वा सुदुर्मतिः।हन्तुं सीतां व्यवसितो वानराभिमुखो ययौ ।। ६.८१.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: mohanārthaṁ tu sarveṣāṁ buddhiṁ kṛtvā sudurmatiḥ।hantuṁ sītāṁ vyavasito vānarābhimukho yayau ।। 6.81.6 ।।

translations.english: Evil minded Indrajith, made up his mind to hoodwink every one who decided to kill Sita and went towards the Vanaras.
translations.hindi: अंगद ने झुर, छुरप्र, नाराच, वत्सदन्त, शिलीमुख, कर्णि शल्य और विपाठ (ये सब वाशो के भेद हैं ) नामक बहुत से पेने तीरों की चोट खाइ, किन्तु पीछे से बलान्‌ एवं प्रतापी बालिपुत्र अंगद ने इस राक्षस का उग्र धनुष, बास और रथ बड़े वेग से तोड़ मरेशड़ डाले

verses.sloka: तं दृष्ट्वा त्वभिनिर्यान्तं नगर्याः काननौकसः।उत्पेतुरभिसङ्क्रुद्धाः शिलाहस्ता युयुत्सवः ।। ६.८१.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ dṛṣṭvā tvabhiniryāntaṁ nagaryāḥ kānanaukasaḥ।utpeturabhisaṅkruddhāḥ śilāhastā yuyutsavaḥ ।। 6.81.7 ।।

translations.english: All the forest animals perceiving Indrajithadvancing became angry and with rocks in hand faced him with enthusiasm.

verses.sloka: हनुमान् पुरतस्तेषां जगाम कपिकुञ्जरः।प्रगृह्य सुमहच्छृङ्गं पर्वतस्य दुरासदम् ।। ६.८१.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: hanumān puratasteṣāṁ jagāma kapikuñjaraḥ।pragṛhya sumahacchṛṅgaṁ parvatasya durāsadam ।। 6.81.8 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman, the elephant among monkeys, taking hold of a huge mountain peak that was difficult to reach marched forward and went.
translations.hindi: तव शोखिताक्ष क्रद्ध हो तुरन्त ढाल तलवार ले बड़ी फुक्ती तेजी से (परिणाम) बिना बिचारे ग्थ से कूद पड़ा

verses.sloka: स ददर्श हतानन्दां सीतामिन्द्रजितो रथे।एकवेणीधरां दीनामुपवासकृशाननाम् ।। ६.८१.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa dadarśa hatānandāṁ sītāmindrajito rathe।ekaveṇīdharāṁ dīnāmupavāsakṛśānanām ।। 6.81.9 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman beheld in the chariot of Indrajith, cheerless Sita with one braid, with no desire to live, emaciated by fasting, wearing a single cloth, body not anointed, covered with dust and dirt all over the body, who was dear to Raghava.

verses.sloka: परिक्लिष्टैकवसनाममृजां राघवप्रियाम्।रजोमलाभ्यामालिप्तैः सर्वगात्रैर्वरस्त्रियम् ।। ६.८१.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: parikliṣṭaikavasanāmamṛjāṁ rāghavapriyām।rajomalābhyāmāliptaiḥ sarvagātrairvarastriyam ।। 6.81.10 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman beheld in the chariot of Indrajith, cheerless Sita with one braid, with no desire to live, emaciated by fasting, wearing a single cloth, body not anointed, covered with dust and dirt all over the body, who was dear to Raghava.
translations.hindi: फिर जैसे बाँये कन्धे से दहिनी कोख तक यज्ञोपवीब् पड़ा रहता है, वेसे हा बाँए कन्थे से दहिनो कोख तक तलवार से शोणिताक्ष के शरीर को अंगद ने काट डाला

verses.sloka: तां निरीक्ष्य मुहूर्तं तु मैथिलीत्यध्यवस्य तु।बभूवाचिरदृष्टा हि तेन सा जनकात्मजा ।। ६.८१.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁ nirīkṣya muhūrtaṁ tu maithilītyadhyavasya tu।babhūvāciradṛṣṭā hi tena sā janakātmajā ।। 6.81.11 ।।

translations.english: He looked at her for a moment and recognised her as Janaka's daughter since he had seen her not long before.
translations.hindi: फिर अंगद उस बड़े खड्ग को हाथ में लिये और बार बार गर्जते हुए समरभूमि में अन्य शत्रुओं पर आक्रमण करने लगे

verses.sloka: तां दीनां मलदिग्धाङ्गीं रथस्थां दृश्य मैथिलीम्।बाष्पपर्याकुलमुखो हनुमान् व्यथितो ऽभवत् ।। ६.८१.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁ dīnāṁ maladigdhāṅgīṁ rathasthāṁ dṛśya maithilīm।bāṣpaparyākulamukho hanumān vyathito 'bhavat ।। 6.81.12 ।।

translations.english: Great Vanara, Hanuman, gazing at miserable, joyless, ascetic woman seated in the chariot, worried, why she is in the chariot. He spoke to the best of Vanara leaders and rushed towards the son of Ravana with them.
translations.hindi: इतने में सुवण के बाजू से शोभित वीर शोणिताक्ष साव- धान हो और एक लोहे की गदा लेकर, अंगद के ऊपर मपटा

verses.sloka: अब्रवीत्तां तु शोकार्तां निरानन्दां तपस्विनीम्।सीतां रथस्थितां दृष्ट्वा राक्षसेन्द्रसुताश्रिताम्।किं समर्थितमस्येति चिन्तयन् स महाकपिः ।। ६.८१.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: abravīttāṁ tu śokārtāṁ nirānandāṁ tapasvinīm।sītāṁ rathasthitāṁ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasendrasutāśritām।kiṁ samarthitamasyeti cintayan sa mahākapiḥ ।। 6.81.13 ।।

translations.english: Great Vanara, Hanuman, gazing at miserable, joyless, ascetic woman seated in the chariot, worried, why she is in the chariot. He spoke to the best of Vanara leaders and rushed towards the son of Ravana with them.
translations.hindi: प्रजंघ के साथ बलवान यूपाक्ष भी क्रुद्ध हो और रथ पर सवार हो, महाबलवान्‌ अंगद का सामना करने को गया

verses.sloka: सह तैर्वानरश्रेष्ठैरभ्यधावत रावणिम् ।। ६.८१.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: saha tairvānaraśreṣṭhairabhyadhāvata rāvaṇim ।। 6.81.14 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith saw the Vanara army coming towards him, deluded with anger, unsheathed the sword and touched Sita's forehead.
translations.hindi: उस समय अंगद शोशिताच ओर प्रजंघ के बीच ऐसे शोभित हो रहे थे ; जैसे दो विशाख नक्षत्रों के बीच पूर्शिमा का चन्द्रमा शोभित होता हे

verses.sloka: तद्वानरबलं दृष्ट्वा रावणिः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः।कृत्वा विकोशं निस्त्रिंशं मूर्ध्नि सीतां परामृशत् ।। ६.८१.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadvānarabalaṁ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇiḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ।kṛtvā vikośaṁ nistriṁśaṁ mūrdhni sītāṁ parāmṛśat ।। 6.81.15 ।।

translations.english: As they were looking at Sita on the chariot trickishly constructed, and she was crying saying, 'O Rama, O Rama', he stood and hit her.

verses.sloka: तां स्त्रियं पश्यतां तेषां ताडयामास रावणिः।क्रोशन्तीं राम रामेति मायया योजितां रथे ।। ६.८१.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁ striyaṁ paśyatāṁ teṣāṁ tāḍayāmāsa rāvaṇiḥ।krośantīṁ rāma rāmeti māyayā yojitāṁ rathe ।। 6.81.16 ।।

translations.english: Seeing Indrajith holding Sita's head, Maruti's son, was immersed in grief, and shed tears of sorrow from his eyes.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर वानर पेड़ों ओर शिला को उठा उठा कर रथा चोड़ों पर और राक्षसों पर फेंकते थे। किन्तु उन सब को यूपाच, बाणा से काट डालता था

verses.sloka: गृहीतमूर्धजां दृष्ट्वा हनुमान् दैन्यमागतः।शोकजं वारि नैत्राभ्यामसृजन्मारुतात्मजः ।। ६.८१.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: gṛhītamūrdhajāṁ dṛṣṭvā hanumān dainyamāgataḥ।śokajaṁ vāri naitrābhyāmasṛjanmārutātmajaḥ ।। 6.81.17 ।।

translations.english: Looking at Rama's dear wife, of lovely limbs, Hanuman rebuked Indrajith in anger and spoke harsh words.
translations.hindi: उस समय परस्पर युद्ध करते हुए, मेन्द, द्विबिद और अंगद इन तीन वानर श्रेष्ठोके साथ प्रजंघ, यूपा और शोणिताक्ष इन तीन राक्षसश्रेष्ठों का घोर एवं रोमददर्पणकारी संग्राम होने लगा

verses.sloka: तां दृष्ट्वा चारुसर्वाङ्गीं रामस्य महिषीं प्रियाम्।अब्रवीत् परुषं वाक्यं क्रोधाद्रक्षोधिपात्मजम् ।। ६.८१.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁ dṛṣṭvā cārusarvāṅgīṁ rāmasya mahiṣīṁ priyām।abravīt paruṣaṁ vākyaṁ krodhādrakṣodhipātmajam ।। 6.81.18 ।।

translations.english: "O evil minded Indrajith! You are born as Rakshasa in the clan of seers of vedic mantras and sought the womb of Rakshasa woman. It is for your own self destruction you seized her hair.

verses.sloka: दुरात्मन्नात्मनाशाय केशपक्षे परामृशः।ब्रह्मर्षीणां कुले जातो राक्षसीं योनिमाश्रितः ।। ६.८१.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: durātmannātmanāśāya keśapakṣe parāmṛśaḥ।brahmarṣīṇāṁ kule jāto rākṣasīṁ yonimāśritaḥ ।। 6.81.19 ।।

translations.english: "You are ignoble, mean, of sinful prowess, not merciful. You have resolved to take such a sinful action which is not worthy of you. You have no compassion to act in this manner."

verses.sloka: धिक् त्वां पापसमाचारं यस्य ते मतिरीदृशी ।। ६.८१.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: dhik tvāṁ pāpasamācāraṁ yasya te matirīdṛśī ।। 6.81.20 ।।

translations.english: "This Mythili is sent away from home, from the kingdom, and also distanced from Rama's protection. You are unkind and hitting in this way. What harm has she done?"
translations.hindi: द्विविद और मैन्द खाड उखाड कर जो पेड फेंकते, उनको प्रतापी शोणिताक्त बीच ही में गदा से टुकड़े टुकड़े कर डालता था

verses.sloka: नृशंसानार्य दुर्वृत्त क्षुद्र पापपराक्रम।अनार्यस्येदृशं कर्म घृणा ते नास्ति निर्घृण ।। ६.८१.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: nṛśaṁsānārya durvṛtta kṣudra pāpaparākrama।anāryasyedṛśaṁ karma ghṛṇā te nāsti nirghṛṇa ।। 6.81.21 ।।

translations.english: "Indeed, you will not live long after killing Sita. You deserve to be killed for your actions, that is why you have come into my hands."
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर शत्र के ममे को चीरने वाली बडी तलवार को उठा कर, प्रजङ्घ बालिपुत्र अङ्गद के कपर बड़े वेग से झपटा

verses.sloka: च्युता गृहाच्च राज्याच्च रामहस्ताच्च मैथिली।किं तवैषा ऽपराद्धा हि यदेनां हन्तुमिच्छसि ।। ६.८१.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: cyutā gṛhācca rājyācca rāmahastācca maithilī।kiṁ tavaiṣā 'parāddhā hi yadenāṁ hantumicchasi ।। 6.81.22 ।।

translations.english: "You deserve to be killed by the world here. Giving up your life, you will be thrown out and descend to the world with those who killed women have gone, after your death."

verses.sloka: सीतां च हत्वा न चिरं जीविष्यसि कथञ्चन।वधार्ह कर्मणा ऽनेन मम हस्तगतो ह्यसि ।। ६.८१.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sītāṁ ca hatvā na ciraṁ jīviṣyasi kathañcana।vadhārha karmaṇā 'nena mama hastagato hyasi ।। 6.81.23 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman was highly enraged and speaking like got prepared for war and went surrounded by the monkeys towards Indrajith, the son of Rakshasa king.
translations.hindi: आर एक घूसा भी उसकी उस बांह में सारा, जिसमें वह तत्क्वार पकड़े हुए था। उस घासे की चोट से उसकी हाथ की तल्बबर छूट कर भूमि पर गिर एड

verses.sloka: ये च स्त्रीघातिनां लोका लोकवध्येषु कुत्सिताः।इह जिवितमुत्सृज्य प्रेत्य तान् प्रतिपत्स्यसे ।। ६.८१.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ye ca strīghātināṁ lokā lokavadhyeṣu kutsitāḥ।iha jivitamutsṛjya pretya tān pratipatsyase ।। 6.81.24 ।।

translations.english: Rakshasa army troops of mighty prowess, terribly angry, were advancing towards wood dwellers (Vanara troops) and were intercepted by the Vanara troops.

verses.sloka: इति ब्रुवाणो हनुमान् सायुधैर्हरिभिर्वृतः।अभ्यधावत सङ्क्रुद्धो राक्षसेन्द्रसुतं प्रति ।। ६.८१.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: iti bruvāṇo hanumān sāyudhairharibhirvṛtaḥ।abhyadhāvata saṅkruddho rākṣasendrasutaṁ prati ।। 6.81.25 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith shattered the army of monkeys with a thousand arrows. Hanuman the foremost Vanara replied to them as follows.

verses.sloka: आपतन्तं महावीर्यं तदनीकं वनौकसाम्।रक्षसां भीमवेगानामनीकं तु न्यवारयत् ।। ६.८१.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: āpatantaṁ mahāvīryaṁ tadanīkaṁ vanaukasām।rakṣasāṁ bhīmavegānāmanīkaṁ tu nyavārayat ।। 6.81.26 ।।

translations.english: "I will kill your Vaidehi today as you keep seeing her for whose sake Sugriva, you and Rama also came here," said Indrajith.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर तेजस्वी एवं प्रतापी बालिपुत्र अगंद ने सावधान हो प्रजङ्क का सिर तेलबार से काट कर प्रथिवी पर गिरा दिआ

verses.sloka: स तां बाणसहस्रेण विक्षोभ्य हरिवाहिनीम्।हरिश्रेष्ठं हनूमन्तमिन्द्रजित् प्रत्युवाच ह ।। ६.८१.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tāṁ bāṇasahasreṇa vikṣobhya harivāhinīm।hariśreṣṭhaṁ hanūmantamindrajit pratyuvāca ha ।। 6.81.27 ।।

translations.english: "O Vanara! This day, having killed her, I will kill Rama, Lakshmana, and you, also Sugriva and that ignoble Vibheeshana."

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवस्त्वं च रामश्च यन्निमित्तमिहागताः।तां हनिष्यामि वैदेहीमद्यैव तव पश्यतः ।। ६.८१.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sugrīvastvaṁ ca rāmaśca yannimittamihāgatāḥ।tāṁ haniṣyāmi vaidehīmadyaiva tava paśyataḥ ।। 6.81.28 ।।

translations.english: "O Hanuman! You said women should not be killed. But whoever causes trouble to the enemy, action should be taken, said Indrajith."

verses.sloka: इमां हत्वा ततो रामं लक्ष्मणं त्वां च वानर।सुग्रीवं च वधिष्यामि तं चानार्यं विभीषणम् ।। ६.८१.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: imāṁ hatvā tato rāmaṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ tvāṁ ca vānara।sugrīvaṁ ca vadhiṣyāmi taṁ cānāryaṁ vibhīṣaṇam ।। 6.81.29 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith having spoken like that killed that crying illusory Sita with a sharpedged sword.

verses.sloka: न हन्तव्याः स्त्रियश्चेति यद्ब्रवीषि प्लवङ्गम।पीडाकरममित्राणां यत् स्यात् कर्तव्यमेव तत् ।। ६.८१.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: na hantavyāḥ striyaśceti yadbravīṣi plavaṅgama।pīḍākaramamitrāṇāṁ yat syāt kartavyameva tat ।। 6.81.30 ।।

translations.english: Split diagonally, the ascetic woman with charming hips and pleasing countenance sank into the ground.
translations.hindi: उस गदा के प्रहार से महाबली द्विविद को गन्नेटा आ गया, किन्तु सावधान होने पर और दूसरी वार गदाप्रहार के लिए उसे उद्यत देख, द्विविद ने उसके हाथ से गदा छीन ली

verses.sloka: तमेवमुक्त्वा रुदतीं सीतां मायामयीं तदा।शितधारेण खड्गेन निजघानेन्द्रजित् स्वयम् ।। ६.८१.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamevamuktvā rudatīṁ sītāṁ māyāmayīṁ tadā।śitadhāreṇa khaḍgena nijaghānendrajit svayam ।। 6.81.31 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith killed that woman and said to Hanuman" see this Vaidehi, Rama's wife, cut up by my sword. Your exertion is useless now."

verses.sloka: यज्ञोपवीतमार्गेण भिन्ना तेन तपस्विनी।सा पृथिव्यां पृथुश्रोणी पपात प्रियदर्शना।तामिन्द्रजित्स्वयं हत्वा हनुमन्तमुवाच ह ।। ६.८१.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: yajñopavītamārgeṇa bhinnā tena tapasvinī।sā pṛthivyāṁ pṛthuśroṇī papāta priyadarśanā।tāmindrajitsvayaṁ hatvā hanumantamuvāca ha ।। 6.81.32 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith killed that woman and said to Hanuman" see this Vaidehi, Rama's wife, cut up by my sword. Your exertion is useless now."

verses.sloka: मया रामस्य पश्येमां कोपेन च निषूदिताम्।एषा विशस्ता वैदेही विफलो वः परिश्रमः ।। ६.८१.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: mayā rāmasya paśyemāṁ kopena ca niṣūditām।eṣā viśastā vaidehī viphalo vaḥ pariśramaḥ ।। 6.81.33 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith himself with his long sword killed her, then rejoiced, he ascended the chariot and roared in a loud tone.

verses.sloka: ततः खड्गेन महता हत्वा तामिन्द्रिजित् स्वयम्।हृष्टः स रथमास्थाय विननाद महास्वनम् ।। ६.८१.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ khaḍgena mahatā hatvā tāmindrijit svayam।hṛṣṭaḥ sa rathamāsthāya vinanāda mahāsvanam ।। 6.81.34 ।।

translations.english: The sound of his roar was heard by the Vanaras waiting for war standing not far from there, which was difficult for Indrajith to access.
translations.hindi: सालमासन्नमेयेत परिजग्राह पाणिना । a कृत्वा! ( शि० ) २ स्कन्घ--सस्कघशाखा + है. हि ४ क क aso ny पु ललल" Tr षट्‌सप्रतितस: सगः = किञ्चिदभ्यवनम्येनस्ुन्ममाथ यथा गजः । तमिन्द्रकेतुतिमं दक्ष मन्दरसन्निभम्‌

verses.sloka: वानराः शुश्रुवुः शब्दमदूरे प्रत्यवस्थिताः।व्यादितास्यस्य नदतस्तहुर्गं संश्रितस्य च ।। ६.८१.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: vānarāḥ śuśruvuḥ śabdamadūre pratyavasthitāḥ।vyāditāsyasya nadatastahurgaṁ saṁśritasya ca ।। 6.81.35 ।।

translations.english: Having thus slain Sita, the evil-minded son of Ravana became exceedingly glad at heart; and beholding him thus rejoicing, the monkeys, dejected of face, fled away.
translations.hindi: इन राक्षस वीरों के मारे जाने पर, रावण की सेना व्यथित हो उस ओर गई जिस ओर कुम्भक का बेटा था

verses.sloka: तथा तु सीतां विनिहत्य दुर्मतिः प्रहृष्टचेताः स बभूव रावणिः।तं हृष्टरूपं समुदीक्ष्य वानरा विषण्णरूपाः सहसा प्रदुद्रुवुः ।। ६.८१.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tathā tu sītāṁ vinihatya durmatiḥ prahṛṣṭacetāḥ sa babhūva rāvaṇiḥ।taṁ hṛṣṭarūpaṁ samudīkṣya vānarā viṣaṇṇarūpāḥ sahasā pradudruvuḥ ।। 6.81.36 ।।

translations.hindi: चटसप्ततितम: सग: ८४५ अपनी सेना को बडे, जोर से भारते देख, कुम्भ ने सैनिकं को धीरज बँधाया । फिर अति उत्कृष्ट एवं महाबलबान्‌ चानरी सेना के मुकावले अपनी सेना को न पाकर और वानरों द्वारा अपने सेना के बडे बडे. वीर योद्धाओं का मारा जाना देख, तेजस्वी कुम्भ ने ऐसी बीरता दिखायी, जो दूसरों के लिये दुष्कर थी

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे एकाशीतितमः सर्गः ।। ८१ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe ekāśītitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 81 ।।
